text: EX-99.1 2 aeva-ex99_1.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Aeva Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results Expanded Product Portfolio in Optical Connectivity with Ultra-High Power Sources and Modules to Address Significant and Growing Demand for AI Data Center Applications US Air Force and US Navy Select Aeva to Develop Airborne Autonomy Capabilities Won Multi-Year Supply Agreement with Micro-Epsilon to Use Aeva for Factory Automation Solutions with Initial Multi-Thousand Sensor Order Received MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., Nov. 4, 2026 – Aeva ® (Nasdaq: AEVA), a leader in next-generation sensing and perception systems, today announced its third quarter 2026 results. Key Company Highlights ● First revenues in Optical Connectivity with deliveries of UHP chipsets to JDA customer for integration and validation; deepening collaboration with JDA customer to jointly pursue interest from additional hyperscalers ● Expanded Optical Connectivity product portfolio with Ultra-High Power (UHP) chipsets, SPECTRA multiwavelength arrays and MESA multichannel assemblies to meet significant and growing demand; increasing momentum across AI compute companies and optical solutions providers, including commercial negotiations with a second optical customer ● Executed on key automotive programs, including growing shipments of production-intent Atlas sensors to Daimler Truck, passing VDA audit for the top 10 European passenger OEM and successfully completing ADAS development program with Bendix ● The US Air Force, together with the US Navy, selected Aeva for joint development using 4D LiDAR to enable new remote sensing and advanced airborne autonomy applications ● Micro-Epsilon selected Aeva’s Eve high-precision technology to enable new levels of performance and versatility in its next-generation factory automation product line; supply agreement includes first multi-thousand sensor order “Aeva achieved a new record revenue in Q3, driven by record volume of our 4D LiDAR and optical solutions and the ongoing scaling of manufacturing,” said Soroush Salehian, Co-Founder and CEO at Aeva. “Our growing traction across many markets, from automotive to optical communications, reflects the unique versatility of Aeva’s core technology platform to deliver differentiated capabilities for a broad range of applications. As demand accelerates, our focus remains on executing for our customers, securing additional wins and further scaling to meet demand.” Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights ● Revenue o Revenue of $6.7 million in Q3 2026, compared to revenue of $3.6 million in Q3 2025 ● GAAP and Non-GAAP Operating Loss* o GAAP operating loss of $39.1 million in Q3 2026, compared to GAAP operating loss of $33.2 million in Q3 2025 o Non-GAAP operating loss of $27.7 million in Q3 2026, compared to non-GAAP operating loss of $27.2 million in Q3 2025 ● GAAP and Non-GAAP Net Income or Loss per Share* o GAAP basic net income per share of $0.06 and diluted net loss per share of $0.54 in Q3 2026, compared to GAAP basic net income per share of $1.86 and diluted net loss per share of $0.52 in Q3 2025 o Non-GAAP basic and diluted net loss per share of $0.39 in Q3 2026, compared to non-GAAP basic and diluted net loss per share of $0.46 in Q3 2025 ● Total Available Liquidity o Total available liquidity of $272.5 million as of September 30, 2026, consisting of $147.5 million in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities and $125.0 million in an available facility ● Shares Outstanding o Weighted basic average shares outstanding of 69.6 million and diluted average shares outstanding of 71.8 million in Q3 2026 *Tables reconciling GAAP to non-GAAP measures are provided at the end of this release. Conference Call Details Aeva will host a conference call and live webcast to discuss results at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET today, November 4, 2026. The live webcast and replay can be accessed at investors.aeva.com . About Aeva Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: AEVA) Aeva’s mission is to bring the next wave of perception to a broad range of applications from automated driving, manufacturing automation and smart infrastructure, to robotics and consumer devices. Aeva is accelerating autonomy with its groundbreaking perception platform that integrates lidar-on-chip technology, system-on-chip processing, and perception algorithms onto silicon leveraging silicon photonics. Aeva 4D LiDAR sensors uniquely detect velocity and position simultaneously, allowing automated devices like vehicles and robots to make more intelligent and safe decisions. For more information, visit www.aeva.com , or connect with us on X or LinkedIn . Non-GAAP Information In addition to our financial results determined in accordance with U.S. GAAP, we present non-GAAP operating loss and non-GAAP net loss per share. “Non-GAAP operating loss” is defined as GAAP operating loss before stock-based compensation and loss on joint development agreement. “Non-GAAP net loss per share” is defined as non-GAAP net loss divided by weighted average shares outstanding, basic and diluted. “Non-GAAP net loss” is defined as GAAP net income (loss) before stock-based compensation, loss on joint development agreement, change in fair value of warrant liabilities and fair value gain on share subscription liability. We believe that non-GAAP operating loss and non-GAAP net loss per share, when taken together with the corresponding U.S. GAAP financial measures, provide meaningful supplemental information regarding our performance by excluding certain items that may not be indicative of our core business, results of operations, or outlook. We consider non-GAAP operating loss and non-GAAP net loss per share to be important measures because they help illustrate underlying trends in our business and our historical operating performance on a more consistent basis. However, non-GAAP financial information is presented for supplemental informational purposes only, has limitations as an analytical tool, and should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for financial information presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP. Non-GAAP financial measures have limitations, including that they exclude certain expenses that are required under GAAP, which adjustments reflect the exercise of judgment by management. In addition, other companies, including companies in our industry, may calculate similarly-titled non-GAAP financial measures or ratios differently or may use other financial measures or ratios to evaluate their performance, all of which could reduce the usefulness of non-GAAP operating loss and non-GAAP net loss per share as tools for comparison. Reconciliations are provided at the end of this release to the most directly comparable financial measures in accordance with U.S. GAAP. Investors are encouraged to review our U.S. GAAP financial measures and not to rely on any single financial measure to evaluate our business.
